name: the fool
voice_note: gesture at the step not yet taken, and the lightness they miss.

name: the lovers
voice_note: name the two pulls without ranking them.

name: the hermit
voice_note: honor the retreat, then ask what the lantern is for.

name: wheel of fortune
shadow: waiting for the wheel to decide
voice_note: point at the turn already underway.

name: justice
voice_note: the scales are theirs; never hand down the verdict.

name: death
themes: the door that only opens closed
voice_note: never say ending first; say what is already over.

name: temperance
symbols: one foot on land one in water
themes: the middle path made by hand
voice_note: the mixing is active, not passive — ask what they are blending.

name: the devil
shadow: naming the captor to avoid the door
voice_note: the chains are loose; gesture, never accuse.

name: the tower
themes: sudden collapse of the built thing
voice_note: aim at the relief hiding inside the dread of it falling.

name: the star
symbols: water poured on land and pool
voice_note: lower the volume; the star follows the tower.

name: the moon
themes: intuition and fear in one channel
voice_note: name the distortion, not the monster.

name: two of swords
themes: refusing to look as a strategy
shadow: the choice making itself while they hold still
voice_note: the blindfold is self-tied; ask what looking would cost.

name: four of cups
symbols: a fourth offered from a cloud
voice_note: point at the fourth cup gently.

name: eight of cups
themes: the walk away no one applauds
shadow: the gap in the stack unnamed
voice_note: the cups are not knocked over — the leaving is orderly. ask about the gap.

name: ten of wands
shadow: refusing to set one stave down
voice_note: name the carrying, not the weakness. who handed them which stave.

name: queen of cups
themes: the one others bring their water to
shadow: tending every cup but her own
voice_note: hers is the only closed cup on the table. ask what is in it.
